content: Jakva lav dǝ li wuse batrǝmud gukh Inabi ǝn dǝva tar

Khalakyana, ka farsa Yasu ad kwaratra lava dǝ jakva lav, ni, “Nǝg udanen a tukhgan ad inabi ǝn gukh sar. Ka tsarghǝran dǝ ghǝrgh. Tǝfgan ad fik pǝrts yu inabiyen, ndǝrar khai ad vak uf chaw kǝ dadak uf gukhen. Ən tǝkhal kǝ yana, ka bǝdu ad mbucha gukhen kǝ yakhaya kǝ li wus, ka dakaval da tlǝrna vak.
Sa kǝ sarta tsǝg inabi, ka ɓǝlandal ad zǝr tlǝr sar da vak li wus gukhen, kǝ chawardǝghǝr tleva sar ǝn gukhen.
Ka vige tara, mbakǝn itar dǝ kǝɗ. Ɓǝlars itar dǝgal dǝ dǝv dliɓ.
Ka ɓǝlanǝf ad tlǝrna zǝr tlǝr sar da vak tar, kǝɗǝf itar ǝn ghǝr, ka tsafanǝf itar.
Ka gwidǝn ɓǝlanǝf ad tlǝrn zǝr tlǝr, ka kǝɗga itar. Ka gwidǝn ɓǝlanǝf ad yakhaya tsugun zikǝn, mbakǝn itar kǝ yakhay dǝ kǝɗ, kǝɗga itar chalǝm kǝmts.
“Tǝma ud fang a tǝmgan kǝ ude da ɓǝlin, in zǝr sar ai ǝn wayin. Ka ɓǝlandal kǝ dǝg mbas, ni, ‘Da farghǝrfǝg itar kǝ zǝrar.’
“Ka kwarakav khai li wus gukhen ǝn tǝb tar, ‘Auna makajen. Ausǝgam, kǝɗyamga kǝɗ, dǝg wura sara da nǝga kǝ dǝgmar.’
Ka viga itar ad zǝr saren kǝɗge tar. Ka tlǝval itar da tǝlg ghǝrgh ad tluvǝgha sar.
“Uɗa da mana dadak gukh kini? Da saks da khadz li tsa wus gukhen, ka da batra kǝ tlǝrna udakh ad gukh inabiyen.
Atsuk a tugwa bakh kur vindzan na kǝ lav Yazhigǝl ai ǝn kwar kwarne,

content.text: in kǝ nala kǝ kur khǝga khwaran.
A nala kǝ dǝg ndawak ǝn diyakh mar tsugun.’ ”

content: Ka gat ɗul vi Yasu kǝ zik zikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh, zǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh, wirva tsa tsitar kwarne ǝn tǝghǝr tsitar a kwarga Yasu ad jakva laven. Ai ǝn gǝdza itar kǝ dzakhava udakh, ka ɗuwars itara, dakaval itar.
Ndiɗǝn tǝghǝr kǝ pǝlara khadam kǝ Kaisar
Ən tǝkhal kǝ yana, ka ɓǝlandal itar ad chalǝm Farisakh zǝ udakh ya Khiridus da vak Yasu, ki zǝɗa viya vi ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ lave da kwarin.

Ka sa itar da vak Yasu, nǝv itar tsin, “Malǝm, tsa tsǝkǝnda kwarne dadak jirkh. Itsawar wikitakw ǝn vakagh. Na khǝn bǝg ghal ǝn udakh bi. Ən tsagdu lav Yazhigǝle jir kha kǝ udakh. Kalkale, awana kalkal bakh pǝlara khadam tsǝkǝnda kǝ Kaisari?
Pǝla nagh kǝnda pǝl bakh kǝndi? Wirva tsa kǝ Yasu kwarne mbaɗirakh itar. Ka ndiɗatǝrwal ni, “Uɗa lava tsukur ǝn na nggaka dlǝgdi? A nakam kwaɓ dawanen nǝgha nǝgha kǝ” ...
Ɓardǝrghǝr itar ad kwaɓen, ka ndiɗatǝrwal, “Vakdiya zǝ ɗakhǝng inǝn tǝfi?” Ka nǝv itar, “Dǝg Kaisar.”
Ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Bamara bǝg kǝ Kaisar ad dǝg Kaisar, kǝ Yazhigǝl tsugun ad dǝg Yazhigǝl.” Ka a ndawatǝrǝf.
Ndiɗǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tsiyin nggitl
Ka tǝkǝn Sadukiyakh, liye ǝn kwar kwarne na tsiyǝn nggitl bi, sara da vak Yasu dǝ ndiɗ.
Nǝv itar, “Malǝm, a vindza kǝnd khai Mus kwarne, da mǝtsǝga zǝrbab sar kǝ udan ɗuwars ad nusar kwal zǝr. Barari wura wura kǝ zǝrbab sar ad widǝgen, kǝ yarkhai zar kǝ zǝrbab saren.
Ai nǝg zǝrbabakhen uɗif. Ka ɓu dǝg chak ad nus mǝtsgan kwal zar.
Ka ɓu dǝg mits ad widǝgen. Ka mǝtsǝga ghǝr sar tsugun, kwal zǝr. Ndǝkyan kǝ dǝg khǝkhǝrɗ tsugun.
Ndǝkvayan kǝ uɗif dagha tar, na ai yakhga zara bi. Kǝ dǝg mbasa, ka mǝtsǝga nusen.
Kina fitsa tsiyen nggitla da nǝga kǝ nusǝngini, fatsiye uɗifdagh tara a zǝɓaruwi?”
Ka nggawa tǝrkhai Yasu, ni, “A zaɗga ba kur bi, fatsiye ǝn tsa ba kur ad kaɗkaɗ lav Yazhigǝla awana ndzǝɗa Yazhigǝl bi.
Da tsiyifud ǝn nggitla, na lav zǝɓ nus zǝ bǝdu sǝba bi, da nǝga ndǝk zar ɓǝla Yazhigǝl ǝn ghǝrazhigǝl itar.

Ai ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tsiyen nggitla, a tugwa bakh kur ǝn kaɗkaɗe vindzga Mus? Ən tǝghǝr kǝ lave kwararkhai Yazhigǝl ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ ndǝgha kar ǝn suya? ‘Ai ka Yazhigǝl Brahim, zǝ Yazhigǝl Ishaku, zǝ Yazhigǝl Yakub kǝ.’
Yazhigǝl tlamtsakh ba ka bi, dǝg liye dǝ safa kǝ. A mangga kur tleɓ”
Zikan kǝ ndzikha ndzikh

Fang ǝn tǝb kǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikhe ǝn vak tar, ǝn tsǝnatǝrval tsǝna ad bǝg tsuguwe ǝn mane tar, ka katlgan kwarne a nggawa tǝrkhai Yasu khwaraniyan. Ka ndiɗarwal, “Ən tǝb kǝ ndzikha ndzikh daghan, ira khwaran ǝmbi?”
Ka nggawar khai Yasu, kwarne, “Ai khwaran na kǝ ndzikha, in ‘Tsǝnam tsǝn, Udakh ya Izrail. Yazhigǝl Dad Zikan mara, Dad Zikan kitakul.
Waya dǝ Dad Zikan Yazhigǝlagh dǝ rǝvakhuɗagh daghan. Dǝ vǝgha daghan. Dǝ mǝkǝnagh daghan. Zǝ ndzǝɗagh daghan.’
Dǝg mitsa in kwarne, “Waya dǝ tlǝghǝrwitǝghagh ndǝkva ghǝragh.’ Na ndzikha ndzikhe malgan ad yakhana bi.”
Ka nǝv dadak tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh, kǝ Yasu, “Kalkal dǝge a kwargakha,” uk Yazhigǝl kitakul na tlǝr bi uk inen.
Waya dǝ Yazhigǝlen dǝ rǝvagha daghan, zǝ mǝkǝnagh daghan, zǝ daghan ndzǝɗagh, zǝ way tlǝghǝrwitǝghagh ndǝkva ghǝragh. In khwaran tǝghǝr kǝ bara digit kǝ Yazhigǝl zǝ dǝg tsuf.”
Vazga kǝ Yasu a nggawar khai kwelemlem, ka niya tsin, “Bita bakh dǝ tlǝksa Yazhigǝl bi.” Ən tǝkhal kǝ yana, na ude a gwidǝn ndiɗarwal bi.
Zǝr warek Kristu ra?
Madv Yasu ǝn tsagdutsag ǝn Fǝta Yazhigǝl, ka ndiɗa tsin kwarne, “Uɗa lava kǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh ǝn kwar kwarne Kristuwa Zǝr Dodi?
Wirva Dod dǝ ghǝr sar, ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ Sǝɗikw Yazhigǝla, a kwargan kwarne,

content.text: khekwa ba ka dǝ li dawagh

content: Dod dǝ ghǝr sara ǝn ɗakha dǝ ‘Dad Zikan.’ Ka da nǝga ndarin kǝ zǝr sari? Zikǝn dzakhava udakh ǝn tsǝn kǝn tsǝna dǝ khwaɗg.
Ndayǝn tǝghǝr kǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh
Madv Yasu ǝn tsagdutsaga, ka ni, “Tsukwamana ghǝr dǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh, li way gwayava dǝ zikzikan kǝ gabag. Ən nagha itar naghatǝrdi nagh zǝ fatǝrghǝrfǝg ǝn tǝ ɓala kasuk.
Zǝ batra vǝj khwaran ǝn gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, zǝ vak khwaran ǝn vak khwadg.
Ən biɗ widǝgakh itar diwa zu dǝgakh tar. Ən zulu zula itar ǝn ɗǝgau, kǝ nǝghatra nǝgha tsud. Khulf yan kǝ udakha da manatra taka lavud char, mal kǝ dǝg yakhaya kǝ udakh.
A bǝdu widǝge talag ad dǝg buti dǝ rǝvakhuɗ kitakul
Ən tǝkhal kǝ yana, ka ndzǝga Yasu khefa dǝ vake ǝn bǝduwud ad dǝg buti, ǝn vaz ɗule ǝn ɗida dzakhava udakh ad kwaɓ tar da vake ǝn bǝduwud ad dǝg buti. Zikǝn tluwandalakhe bakhdagh ad kwaɓ tar ɗǝmbǝr.
Ai ka sa widǝge talag, ka bǝdagh ad kalami vǝrshakanv mits, ai kwal do dat kwaɓ kitakul.
Ka Dakhga Yasu ad furakh sar da vak sar, ka ni, ǝn tǝkha kura tǝkha kǝ, kwaɓe a bǝdagh widǝg na da dǝg ɗi dǝg buti na, a malgan ad dǝg itsawar daghan.
Wirva daghan tara khǝɗikǝn a bǝdu itar ǝn zika dǝge din itar. Ai widǝg na ǝn talag sar a bǝduwin ad ɗaga dǝge dinin.
